_comment: Authoritative concept -> SpriteType overrides for `sprites:backfill-manifest-types`. Consulted after catalog-tag and brief-YAML resolution, before the conservative prefix heuristic. Keyed by NORMALIZED concept (normalizeConcept: variant/version suffixes like -v1, -var-2, -placeholder stripped). Only add a concept here when its briefs/runs are gone AND the catalog carries no usable type tag for it, so the cascade genuinely cannot recover the type. Every value must be one of the SPRITE_TYPES. See docs/agent-os/sprite-style.md and scripts/sprites/reference-selector.ts.

_reasoning.bent-pipe: Improvised melee weapon wielded by the player/mobs.
_reasoning.baseball-bat: Melee weapon; concept-cascade usually rescues it, kept here as a belt-and-suspenders anchor.
